q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Wang Fang. I’m fourteen years old. I live in Chengdu, in the south-west of China. I live with my mum, my dad and my little brother. I use my mobile phone every evening, mainly to send messages to my friends, but my parents don’t let me use it for too long. My favourite time of day is the morning, because I feel fresh and I can think clearly. In the future I’d like to visit Australia, because I want to see kangaroos and the beautiful beaches. I love listening to rock music, because it’s full of energy. Yes, I enjoy shopping, especially for books and clothes with my friends at the weekend. I’d like to study medicine in the future, because I want to help sick people. On television I like watching cooking programmes, because I can learn how to make new dishes. I like reading comics and detective stories, because they’re fun and exciting.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答不只回答“是/不是”或一个词，而是给出具体信息并说明理由（because…），用一般现在时谈习惯和爱好，用 I’d like to… 谈将来的打算，每个问题说 1–3 句。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photo I can see two young people doing homework together. I think they’re students, maybe brother and sister or friends. They’re sitting at a big table, and it looks like a kitchen at home, because I can see a toaster at the back. The boy is wearing a white T-shirt and he’s writing something in an exercise book. The girl next to him has long fair hair and she’s smiling, so maybe the homework isn’t too difficult. Perhaps she is helping him. On the table there’s a laptop, a pot of pens and some books. The room looks bright and sunny. I think they’re happy to work together, because it’s easier and more fun than working alone.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答按顺序描述照片：人物（是谁、穿什么、在做什么、心情如何）、地点、桌上的其他物品；用现在进行时，遇到不确定的地方用 I think / maybe / perhaps / it looks like… 猜测，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. The flowers are a nice idea, because they enjoy growing flowers and they can plant them in the garden. The hat and gloves are useful too. They can wear them when they work outside in the sun, and they’ll think of their grandchildren. You’re right about the chocolates – they’re nice, but they’ll eat them quickly and then they’re gone. The photo is lovely, because it’s something they can keep for a long time. But maybe they already have lots of photos. The little tree is good, because they could grow their own fruit. I’m not sure about the book – they probably know a lot about vegetables already. I think the hat and gloves are the best, because they can use them every day. Yes, let’s choose those. We agree!

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每一个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），把每件礼物和“祖父母住在乡下、喜欢种花种菜”联系起来，用 I think / You’re right / What about…? / Let’s… 推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最好的礼物。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, we learn about plants and animals in biology lessons. I think it’s interesting, especially when we do experiments. In the countryside I like walking and picking fruit, because the air is fresh and it’s very quiet. I enjoy watching TV programmes about nature, because I can see animals from all over the world. I don’t think living in the countryside is always better. It’s peaceful, but in a city there are more schools, shops and hospitals. I think it’s important to spend time in the countryside, because it helps us relax and we can learn about nature.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都表明观点并给出理由或例子，用一般现在时谈经历和爱好，用 I think / because / but 表达看法，还可以从正反两方面比较乡村和城市。
